subject: Short notice: demo conflicts with onsite workshop — options?
messages:
From: Samantha Blake <samantha@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Collins <j.collins@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Short notice: demo conflicts with onsite workshop — options?

Hi Marissa / Evelyn,

Quick heads up — we have a leadership workshop that just got extended unexpectedly on 9/7 from 10:00–13:00 PT. Our original 9/7 demo slot with your team is at 11:00 PT and now overlaps with several of our stakeholders. We still want the walkthrough; main ask is whether we can either: (A) compress to a focused 30-minute technical sync with just the engineering leads, or (B) keep the 60-minute slot but record the first 30min and only have the execs join for the last 30.

If neither works, we may need to push to next week — preference is to avoid that because we want to align before our roadmap review on 9/12.

Attached is our Q3 priorities doc so you can see which parts we care about most.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Blake
Director, Platform Operations
Greenline Health

Attachment: Greenline_Priorities_Q3.pdf (pdf)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Blake <samantha@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-04T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice: demo conflicts with onsite workshop — options?

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads up and for sending the priorities doc. Either option is workable on our side; I've sketched two concrete plans so you can pick quickly: 

Option A — Focused 30m (engineering-only)
- 30 minutes, deep technical walkthrough covering inference latency, model variants, and deployment modes (hosted vs private).
- Attendees: your engineering leads + Evelyn (SE) + Karthik (Solutions Architect).
- Outcome: confirm perf targets and any proof-of-concept scope.

Option B — 60m with recording + executive skip
- We record first 30 (technical deep-dive); last 30 intended for exec Q&A and high-level ROI/cost discussion.
- We can provide a short recorded clip plus a 1-page exec summary after the call.

If you want to keep the full slot for execs, we can still trim content and prioritize the roadmap items you attached (I highlighted 2–3 bullets to show on the shared screen).

Suggested next steps: reply with A or B and confirm attendees. If you pick A, I can send a condensed agenda (30 min) and a calendar update. If B, we'll record and circulate the clip + exec summary immediately after.

Happy to be flexible — want to make sure we hit the items that matter to you before your roadmap review.

— Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Blake <samantha@greenlinehealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-04T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice: demo conflicts with onsite workshop — options?

Thanks Evelyn — I agree on both plans. Samantha — if you're open to Option A (30m engineering-only), we can still schedule a 20–25 minute async exec summary: I can record a 10-minute highlight and drop a 1-page one-pager and cost estimate into the thread so your execs can review before the 9/12 roadmap meeting. That keeps momentum for the deal.

If you prefer Option B, we'll plan to record the first half — Evelyn / Karthik will mark timestamps for the key sections so the recording is scannable. Either way I can prepare:
- 30m focused agenda (Evelyn)
- 10m exec highlight recording (me)
- 1-pager ROI + initial sizing (attached draft)

Proposed quick decision: choose A or B by EOD today so we can update calendars and I can produce the exec highlight.

Attachments: Proposed-Agenda-30m.docx (docx)
HubSpot: HS-46271 (I added milestones & next steps)

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Blake <samantha@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Collins <j.collins@greenlinehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Short notice: demo conflicts with onsite workshop — options?

Marissa / Evelyn — thanks for the quick options. We'll go with Option A: 30 minutes with engineering leads only. Please do the 10-minute exec highlight recording and the 1-pager so I can circulate to the leadership team ahead of 9/12.

Attendees for 30m:
- Samantha Blake (Platform Ops)
- Jordan Collins (VP Eng) — may join for the first 10
- Michael Torres (Lead SRE)

Evelyn — can you send the condensed agenda and calendar update? Marissa — if you can drop the exec highlight by 9/6 EOD, that would be perfect.

Appreciate the flexibility.

Samantha
